annotations.title: Is this becoming material to companies?

description: Use when the user asks whether a risk, technology or theme is spreading through public companies, or whether companies now treat it as material. Returns, year by year, the share of U.S. 10-K filers that mention the phrase, from SEC EDGAR full-text search, with a denominator control ("competition") and a null control ("shrinkflation") that must read 0. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $2.00 per run, charged only when the run comes back sound; pay over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token) or x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed). A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/filing-trend.json

end.description: Last year, not in the future. Default: this year. At most 10 years per run.

phrase.description: The phrase to count, without quote marks, e.g. "tariff" or "GLP-1".

start.description: First year (2001 onward). Default: four years ago.
